name: Plur na mBan

attributes.attribute: daughter of the fairy queen Niam a of the Golden Hair
child of the human poet Oisín

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Plur na mBan is a minor Irish heroine. Her name means flower of womanhood. She was the daughter of the fairy queen Niamh of the Golden Hair and her chosen love, the human poet Oisín.

okr.objective: Describe Plur na mBan and her lineage to the fairy queen and her poet.
key_results: Translate the name flower of womanhood.
Name her parents, Niamh and the poet Oisín.
